heading: The Impasse of Human Wisdom

heading: The physical and moral gradients of the colossus
ascii:

heading: The Divided Kingdoms and the Mirage of Unity
ascii:
THE POST-ROMAN DILEMMA (DANIEL 2:43)
Iron (strength that remains)  +  Clay (the mixture that will not hold)
             -                                   -
             ---- Mechanical Mixture, Not Union --
                                 -
                   "THEY SHALL NOT CLEAVE"
    - Charlemagne (800)          - Charles V (1519)
    - Napoleon (1804-1815)       - Hitler (1939-1945)
    [Every attempt to rebuild a single European empire fractures]
